text:
carmen: quick RFC follow-up — proposal to split onboarding into two clear surfaces: (1) intake/benching (smoke + golden checks) and (2) runtime canaries/profiling. aim is faster admit + later deeper perf validation. thoughts?

---
dinesh: ok on paper. main risk is mismatch between bench env and runtime KV/cache behaviour. we've seen pass-on-smoke but fail-at-scale because of kv eviction patterns. :thinking_face:

alice: agree with split but we need deterministic golden traces for both surfaces. bench should validate functional parity + tokenization, runtime canaries should run throughput/latency/kv-health.

ben: what about rollout shape? tiny shadow traffic + short canary window often misses fat-tail latencies. propose: shadow 10% for 2h, then 1% for 24h with periodic tail-sampling.

carmen: I like shadow-first. tradeoff: cost and noise in metrics. propose autoscale-enabled canary workers with sampling config. keep smokehouse strict for correctness so we don't leak bad artifacts.

maria: rollback policy sketch — auto rollback if P99 latency increases > 15% AND error rate > 0.5% for 5m. manual override for infra-driven spikes. also prefer incremental quantization toggles (q4 -> q4-bit+ runtime check).

alice: adding to that — need a quick lightweight runtime probe that exercises long-context paths (KV warming). bench can't emulate long-lived KV growth well. the probe should be synthetic but reproducible: use golden conversation seeds.

ben: sample config I’m imagining:
```yaml
onboard:
  smoke:
    checks: [tokenizer, output-shape, basic-safety]
    timeout: 20m
  canary:
    shadow_fraction: 0.10
    shadow_duration: 2h
    rollout_fraction: 0.01
    rollout_duration: 24h
    rollback_conditions:
      - p99_latency_increase_pct: 15
      - error_rate_pct: 0.5
    tail_sampling: every 15m
```

carmen: nice. also add a compatibility matrix entry for kernel/quantization combos so runtime can auto-select fallback binaries if mismatch detected.

maria: +1. we should also capture a small artifact bundle with each intake: (model fingerprint, tokenizer hash, sample golden inputs, perf-profile hints). store immutable snapshot in registry so canary can reference exact artifact.

dinesh: operational notes: make sure canary workers reuse same KV bucket namespace but with tagging to avoid user-data collision. and include evict-stress test in canary to catch eviction regressions.

alice: on metrics, record per-request KV hit/miss, per-shard CPU/GPU utilization, per-model tail-latency histogram. need hooks in runtime to surface these with labels: model_id, quantization, kernel_variant.

ben: quick CLI for ops to trigger an expedited canary: `redwood onboard --model my-model --expedite --shadow 0.2 --duration 1h` — should be gated by perms.

maria: automation idea: if eval-quality metrics (bleu/qa/rouge or cust evals) change > threshold during canary, pause rollout even if perf is OK. double-gate.

carmen: ok action items:
- ben: draft canary rollout CF template + CLI (ETA 2d)
- alice: runtime probe spec + golden seeds (ETA 3d)
- dinesh: eviction stress test + KV tagging approach (ETA 4d)
- maria: rollback + quality gating rules to formalize (ETA 2d)
- carmen: update intake proto to include artifact bundle fields (ETA 2d)

ben: noted. will include example dashboards for tail-latency and KV metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline status: smokehouse v2 passed for latest intake harness. :white_check_mark:

alice: one more wrinkle — what about models that are fast to serve but have stochastic outputs that shift eval metrics under different RNG seeds? bench needs to include seeded regen checks and runtime canary should run multiple seeds per sample. small sampling though.

maria: yep — include randomness seed sweep in smoke checks, but keep it cheap (3 seeds/sample). runtime canary does heavier sweep if flagged.

carmen: thanks everyone — will consolidate into a short RFC addendum and link back here. :sparkles:
